name: luring song
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 ft. of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that can hear the song must succeed on a  DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is incapacitated.
While charmed by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, the target must move on its turn toward the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, the target can repeat the saving throw. A charmed target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.
A target that successfully saves is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s song for the next 24 hours.
